configuration.top_k_source: multiseed_validation_sweep (3 seeds: 42,1,2), range 15-35, prototype consultant, no test labels

source_artifacts.command: python -m src.pipeline.common.run_pipeline --dataset ton_iot --only fusion oof prototypes top_k_sweep feedback ladder

supersedes.reason: Schema 4 was produced on the v1 edge encoding and before the loop-fusion fairness fix (see unsw_nb15_current.json supersedes note). Schema 5 re-runs on v2 encoding with the fix in place. The AGAF rung, previously the top rung on ToN, DROPS under v2 (0.4447->0.3334) and falls below the GNN rung, which the fix does not touch; the loop rung, previously below AGAF, is now the top rung and significantly above AGAF. This reverses the schema-4 headline finding.

earlier_reproducibility_note.reason: The previous ToN prototype ladder (GNN 0.3398, LLM 0.2785, AGAF 0.4447, Loop 0.4538, 'ladder holds') does not reproduce. Re-running the unchanged code on the unchanged graph, folds and seed yields GNN 0.3271 and Loop 0.3876. The LLM and AGAF rungs reproduce to 4 decimals; only the two rungs that made the ladder hold do not. The Aug-13 oof_logits.pt artifact preserved in processed_aug06_backup/ also scores 0.3271, so 0.3398 was never obtainable from the stored artifacts.

limitations: AGAF regressed under v2 encoding and is now significantly BELOW the GNN rung (0.3334 vs 0.4290, P=0.0005) — the sole reason the canonical GNN&LLM<AGAF ladder shape fails on ToN. Root cause not yet diagnosed; do not describe AGAF as the strongest ToN rung until this is resolved.
The LLM rung (0.2785) sits BELOW the GNN rung (0.4290). The whitened-prototype scorer collapses under this graph's imbalance: rare classes have 12-35 edges.
Classes 3 (dos, 4 edges) and 7 (ransomware, 3 edges) remain in the graph for message passing but are excluded from the metric. A 10-class macro-F1 on this graph is not a reportable number.
Edge aggregation is label-conditioned through (src_ip, dst_ip, attack_type).

Single-seed pooled-OOF point estimate; ToN seed variance measured at ~0.02 elsewhere in this repo (see results/ton_iot_balancing.json) so treat point differences under ~0.02 as noise pending a multi-seed re-run on v2.
